import json, numpy as np, os

MAT="/workspace"
cams=json.load(open(f"{MAT}/cameras.json"))
queries=json.load(open(f"{MAT}/queries.json"))

# ---- Canonical right-hand model, metres, local frame ----
# local frame: +Y = fingers direction (distal), +X = radial (thumb side),
# +Z = out of palm (toward back of hand). Wrist at origin.
# Joint order (0..19):
# 0 thumb_tip,1 index_tip,2 middle_tip,3 ring_tip,4 pinky_tip,5 wrist,
# 6 thumb_inter,7 thumb_distal,8 index_prox,9 index_inter,10 index_distal,
# 11 middle_prox,12 middle_inter,13 middle_distal,14 ring_prox,15 ring_inter,
# 16 ring_distal,17 pinky_prox,18 pinky_inter,19 pinky_distal

def canonical(curl=0.0):
    # MCP knuckle positions
    idx_mcp =np.array([ 0.022, 0.090, 0.0])
    mid_mcp =np.array([ 0.003, 0.097, 0.0])
    rng_mcp =np.array([-0.017, 0.092, 0.0])
    pnk_mcp =np.array([-0.036, 0.082, 0.0])
    # phalanx lengths (prox->inter, inter->distal, distal->tip)
    L={'index':(0.043,0.026,0.021),'middle':(0.047,0.030,0.023),
       'ring':(0.043,0.028,0.021),'pinky':(0.033,0.020,0.018)}
    def finger(mcp,lens):
        # bend fingers by 'curl' about x axis progressively (grasp)
        pts=[mcp]
        d=np.array([0.0,1.0,0.0]); p=mcp.copy()
        ang=curl
        for i,l in enumerate(lens):
            # rotate direction about local x (bend toward palm, +Z? palm side = -Z)
            c,s=np.cos(ang),np.sin(ang)
            d=np.array([d[0], d[1]*c - d[2]*s, d[1]*s + d[2]*c])
            # bend toward palm side (-Z): make z negative
            d=np.array([d[0], d[1], -abs(d[2]) if ang>0 else d[2]])
            p=p+l*d
            pts.append(p.copy())
            ang+=curl*0.6
        return pts  # [mcp,inter,distal,tip]
    ix=finger(idx_mcp,L['index'])
    mi=finger(mid_mcp,L['middle'])
    rg=finger(rng_mcp,L['ring'])
    pk=finger(pnk_mcp,L['pinky'])
    # thumb: base off radial side, points up-radial; joints inter,distal,tip
    th_inter=np.array([0.040,0.035,0.010])
    th_distal=th_inter+np.array([0.022,0.022,0.006])
    th_tip=th_distal+np.array([0.018,0.018,0.004])
    J=np.zeros((20,3))
    J[5]=[0,0,0]                 # wrist
    J[8],J[9],J[10],J[1]=ix       # index prox,inter,distal,tip
    J[11],J[12],J[13],J[2]=mi
    J[14],J[15],J[16],J[3]=rg
    J[17],J[18],J[19],J[4]=pk
    J[6],J[7],J[0]=th_inter,th_distal,th_tip
    return J

def euler(rx,ry,rz):
    cx,sx=np.cos(rx),np.sin(rx); cy,sy=np.cos(ry),np.sin(ry); cz,sz=np.cos(rz),np.sin(rz)
    Rx=np.array([[1,0,0],[0,cx,-sx],[0,sx,cx]])
    Ry=np.array([[cy,0,sy],[0,1,0],[-sy,0,cy]])
    Rz=np.array([[cz,-sz,0],[sz,cz,0],[0,0,1]])
    return Rz@Ry@Rx

def project(J,cam):
    u=cam['fx']*J[:,0]/J[:,2]+cam['cx']
    v=cam['fy']*J[:,1]/J[:,2]+cam['cy']
    return np.stack([u,v],1)

# Per-clip pose parameters (tuned to observed frames):
# rx,ry,rz euler on canonical; wrist pixel (u,v); wrist depth Z; curl; mirror handedness
POSES={
 # clip1: palm faces camera, fingers point up & left, holding mouse (moderate curl)
 'clip_01': dict(rx=-2.55, ry=0.15, rz=1.35, u=735,v=860, Z=0.34, curl=0.35),
 # clip2: back of hand toward camera, fingers up toward wall, arm extended (further)
 'clip_02': dict(rx=-1.25, ry=0.10, rz=0.15, u=795,v=650, Z=0.58, curl=0.25),
 # clip3: back of hand up, fingers point up-left toward phone, on table
 'clip_03': dict(rx=-1.35, ry=-0.20, rz=0.85, u=690,v=830, Z=0.46, curl=0.20),
}

def build(clip):
    cam=cams[clip]; p=POSES[clip]
    J=canonical(p['curl'])
    R=euler(p['rx'],p['ry'],p['rz'])
    Jr=(R@J.T).T
    # place wrist at desired pixel & depth
    Zc=p['Z']
    Xc=(p['u']-cam['cx'])*Zc/cam['fx']
    Yc=(p['v']-cam['cy'])*Zc/cam['fy']
    wrist_target=np.array([Xc,Yc,Zc])
    Jr=Jr - Jr[5] + wrist_target
    return Jr

if __name__=="__main__":
    for c in POSES:
        J=build(c)
        px=project(J,cams[c])
        print(c,"wrist_px",px[5].round(1),"Zrange",J[:,2].min().round(3),J[:,2].max().round(3))
        print("  tips px thumb,idx,mid,ring,pnk:")
        for i in [0,1,2,3,4]:
            print("   ",px[i].round(0))

import numpy as np, json, sys
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from build_hand import build, project, cams, POSES

MAT="/workspace"
FRAMES={'clip_01':'clip_01_f2034.png','clip_02':'clip_02_f2135.png','clip_03':'clip_03_f1932.png'}

# bones connecting joints (indices)
BONES=[(5,8),(8,9),(9,10),(10,1),      # index
       (5,11),(11,12),(12,13),(13,2),  # middle
       (5,14),(14,15),(15,16),(16,3),  # ring
       (5,17),(17,18),(18,19),(19,4),  # pinky
       (5,6),(6,7),(7,0)]              # thumb

clip=sys.argv[1]
J=build(clip); px=project(J,cams[clip])
im=Image.open(f"{MAT}/{FRAMES[clip]}").convert("RGB")
d=ImageDraw.Draw(im)
for a,b in BONES:
    d.line([tuple(px[a]),tuple(px[b])],fill=(0,255,0),width=3)
for i,(u,v) in enumerate(px):
    r=5; col=(255,0,0) if i==5 else (0,150,255)
    d.ellipse([u-r,v-r,u+r,v+r],fill=col)
im.save(f"/tmp/ov_{clip}.png")
print("saved",clip)

input.content:
import json, numpy as np

MAT="/workspace"
cams=json.load(open(f"{MAT}/cameras.json"))

# Joint order:
# 0 thumb_tip,1 index_tip,2 middle_tip,3 ring_tip,4 pinky_tip,5 wrist,
# 6 thumb_inter,7 thumb_distal,8 index_prox,9 index_inter,10 index_distal,
# 11 middle_prox,12 middle_inter,13 middle_distal,14 ring_prox,15 ring_inter,
# 16 ring_distal,17 pinky_prox,18 pinky_inter,19 pinky_distal

# Canonical right hand in local frame:
#   +Y  = finger pointing direction (wrist -> fingertips)
#   +X  = from pinky toward thumb (radial)  [right hand, palm toward -Z]
#   +Z  = palm-normal pointing OUT OF the palm (toward viewer when palm faces camera)
def canonical(curl):
    # MCP knuckles (metres) in local frame
    mcp={'index':np.array([ 0.020,0.088,0]),
         'middle':np.array([ 0.001,0.095,0]),
         'ring':np.array([-0.018,0.090,0]),
         'pinky':np.array([-0.036,0.080,0])}
    L={'index':(0.043,0.026,0.021),'middle':(0.047,0.030,0.023),
       'ring':(0.043,0.028,0.021),'pinky':(0.033,0.020,0.018)}
    cf={'index':1.0,'middle':1.0,'ring':1.05,'pinky':1.1}
    out={}
    for f in mcp:
        pts=[mcp[f].copy()]
        # direction starts along +Y, curls toward palm (-Z) as it goes distal
        p=mcp[f].copy(); ang=0.0
        d=np.array([0.0,1.0,0.0])
        for i,l in enumerate(L[f]):
            ang+=curl*cf[f]*(0.8 if i==0 else 1.1)
            c,s=np.cos(ang),np.sin(ang)
            d=np.array([0.0, np.cos(ang), -np.sin(ang)])
            p=p+l*d
            pts.append(p.copy())
        out[f]=pts  # [mcp,inter,distal,tip]
    # thumb: sits on radial side, splayed, pointing up-radial, slightly toward camera(+Z)
    tb_cmc=np.array([0.030,0.020,0.005])
    tdir=np.array([0.55,0.80,0.25]); tdir=tdir/np.linalg.norm(tdir)
    tang=curl*0.5
    inter=tb_cmc+0.035*tdir
    d2=tdir.copy()
    distal=inter+0.024*(d2+np.array([0,0,-np.sin(tang)]))/np.linalg.norm(d2+np.array([0,0,-np.sin(tang)]))
    tip=distal+0.020*(d2+np.array([0,0,-1.4*np.sin(tang)]))/np.linalg.norm(d2+np.array([0,0,-1.4*np.sin(tang)]))
    J=np.zeros((20,3))
    J[5]=[0,0,0]
    J[8],J[9],J[10],J[1]=out['index']
    J[11],J[12],J[13],J[2]=out['middle']
    J[14],J[15],J[16],J[3]=out['ring']
    J[17],J[18],J[19],J[4]=out['pinky']
    J[6],J[7],J[0]=inter,distal,tip
    return J

def frame_from(finger_dir, palm_normal):
    """Build rotation whose columns are local X,Y,Z axes in camera frame.
    finger_dir -> +Y, palm_normal -> +Z, X = Y cross Z (right-handed-ish)."""
    y=np.array(finger_dir,float); y/=np.linalg.norm(y)
    z=np.array(palm_normal,float)

import json, numpy as np, os

MAT="/workspace"
cams=json.load(open(f"{MAT}/cameras.json"))
queries=json.load(open(f"{MAT}/queries.json"))

# ---- Canonical right-hand model, metres, local frame ----
# local frame: +Y = fingers direction (distal), +X = radial (thumb side),
# +Z = out of palm (toward back of hand). Wrist at origin.
# Joint order (0..19):
# 0 thumb_tip,1 index_tip,2 middle_tip,3 ring_tip,4 pinky_tip,5 wrist,
# 6 thumb_inter,7 thumb_distal,8 index_prox,9 index_inter,10 index_distal,
# 11 middle_prox,12 middle_inter,13 middle_distal,14 ring_prox,15 ring_inter,
# 16 ring_distal,17 pinky_prox,18 pinky_inter,19 pinky_distal

def canonical(curl=0.0):
    # MCP knuckle positions
    idx_mcp =np.array([ 0.022, 0.090, 0.0])
    mid_mcp =np.array([ 0.003, 0.097, 0.0])
    rng_mcp =np.array([-0.017, 0.092, 0.0])
    pnk_mcp =np.array([-0.036, 0.082, 0.0])
    # phalanx lengths (prox->inter, inter->distal, distal->tip)
    L={'index':(0.043,0.026,0.021),'middle':(0.047,0.030,0.023),
       'ring':(0.043,0.028,0.021),'pinky':(0.033,0.020,0.018)}
    def finger(mcp,lens):
        # bend fingers by 'curl' about x axis progressively (grasp)
        pts=[mcp]
        d=np.array([0.0,1.0,0.0]); p=mcp.copy()
        ang=curl
        for i,l in enumerate(lens):
            # rotate direction about local x (bend toward palm, +Z? palm side = -Z)
            c,s=np.cos(ang),np.sin(ang)
            d=np.array([d[0], d[1]*c - d[2]*s, d[1]*s + d[2]*c])
            # bend toward palm side (-Z): make z negative
            d=np.array([d[0], d[1], -abs(d[2]) if ang>0 else d[2]])
            p=p+l*d
            pts.append(p.copy())
            ang+=curl*0.6
        return pts  # [mcp,inter,distal,tip]
    ix=finger(idx_mcp,L['index'])
    mi=finger(mid_mcp,L['middle'])
    rg=finger(rng_mcp,L['ring'])
    pk=finger(pnk_mcp,L['pinky'])
    # thumb: base off radial side, points up-radial; joints inter,distal,tip
    th_inter=np.array([0.040,0.035,0.010])
    th_distal=th_inter+np.array([0.022,0.022,0.006])
    th_tip=th_distal+np.array([0.018,0.018,0.004])
    J=np.zeros((20,3))
    J[5]=[0,0,0]                 # wrist
    J[8],J[9],J[10],J[1]=ix       # index prox,inter,distal,tip
    J[11],J[12],J[13],J[2]=mi
    J[14],J[15],J[16],J[3]=rg
    J[17],J[18],J[19],J[4]=pk
    J[6],J[7],J[0]=th_inter,th_distal,th_tip
    return J

def euler(rx,ry,rz):
    cx,sx=np.cos(rx),np.sin(rx); cy,sy=np.cos(ry),np.sin(ry); cz,sz=np.cos(rz),np.sin(rz)
    Rx=np.array([[1,0,0],[0,cx,-sx],[0,sx,cx]])
    Ry=np.array([[cy,0,sy],[0,1,0],[-sy,0,cy]])
    Rz=np.array([[cz,-sz,0],[sz,cz,0],[0,0,1]])
    return Rz@Ry@Rx

def project(J,cam):
    u=cam['fx']*J[:,0]/J[:,2]+cam['cx']
    v=cam['fy']*J[:,1]/J[:,2]+cam['cy']
    return np.stack([u,v],1)

# Per-clip pose parameters (tuned to observed frames):
# rx,ry,rz euler on canonical; wrist pixel (u,v); wrist depth Z; curl; mirror handedness
POSES={
 # clip1: palm faces camera, fingers point up & left, holding mouse (moderate curl)
 'clip_01': dict(rx=-2.55, ry=0.15, rz=1.35, u=735,v=860, Z=0.34, curl=0.35),
 # clip2: back of hand toward camera, fingers up toward wall, arm extended (further)
 'clip_02': dict(rx=-1.25, ry=0.10, rz=0.15, u=795,v=650, Z=0.58, curl=0.25),
 # clip3: back of hand up, fingers point up-left toward phone, on table
 'clip_03': dict(rx=-1.35, ry=-0.20, rz=0.85, u=690,v=830, Z=0.46, curl=0.20),
}

def build(clip):
    cam=cams[clip]; p=POSES[clip]
    J=canonical(p['curl'])
    R=euler(p['rx'],p['ry'],p['rz'])
    Jr=(R@J.T).T
    # place wrist at desired pixel & depth
    Zc=p['Z']
    Xc=(p['u']-cam['cx'])*Zc/cam['fx']
    Yc=(p['v']-cam['cy'])*Zc/cam['fy']
    wrist_target=np.array([Xc,Yc,Zc])
    Jr=Jr - Jr[5] + wrist_target
    return Jr

if __name__=="__main__":
    for c in POSES:
        J=build(c)
        px=project(J,cams[c])
        print(c,"wrist_px",px[5].round(1),"Zrange",J[:,2].min().round(3),J[:,2].max().round(3))
        print("  tips px thumb,idx,mid,ring,pnk:")
        for i in [0,1,2,3,4]:
            print("   ",px[i].round(0))
